title: community-skills: An R-focused hub of agent-callable skills for the CRAN ecosystem (v0.2.0)
description: community-skills is an R-focused hub that turns CRAN packages into machine-readable skills that LLM agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, third-party tools) can invoke autonomously. Each skill ships a SKILL.md contract (function-level schemas), an invoke dispatcher (invoke.R for CRAN packages, invoke.py for in-tree infrastructure), and a thin per-runtime bridge (subprocess + JSON) that any agent harness can drive. v0.2.0 ships: (a) cran_graph, a portable SQLite snapshot of the entire CRAN dependency graph with typed edges and machine-readable deprecation flags plus a greedy install-set optimizer; (b) cran_publisher, with two distribution channels, the CRAN side (R CMD check parser, categorizer, Gemma-driven fix loop, submission preflight, gated submit) and the r-universe side (readiness preflight, packages.json register, build-status query); (c) cran_workflow, a composition skill that audits a CRAN release end-to-end; (d) autoresearch, an autonomous optimization loop with a local LLM critic; (e) bgumbel as the canonical wrapped CRAN package (Otiniano, Vila, Brom, Bourguignon 2023; ~48,000 CRAN downloads; 10 citing papers); and (f) 105 additional R skills drafted by Gemma 4 26b-fast and promoted after structural smoke validation, 90 from the cranlogs top-100 of 2026-05-09 plus 15 from the harness sister-package curation queue of 2026-06-04. Project scope is R; Python and Julia external-package wrappers are out of scope (decision 2026-05-09). Sister package harness (under r-cs-packages/harness/) consumes this hub as a role-curated catalogue for command-line coding agents.
